<!-- wuwa-mac-minimum: 13.0 -->

## Changelog

- Fixed chest countdowns losing elapsed time while the Mac is asleep in both CN and Global builds. Countdowns catch up on the first refresh after wake, including newly started chest timers.

## Instructions

- Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later.
- Choose the `CN` package for a mainland China account or `Global` for a Global account.
- In mac.5 or later, open Settings → Check for Updates → Update and Restart. macOS may request administrator approval.
- For manual installation, quit the existing app and replace it with `Wuwa Tappo.app` from the matching DMG or ZIP.
- If macOS blocks launch, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
- Both packages contain `Wuwa Tappo.app`. Install them in separate folders to keep both regions.
- Use DMG/ZIP files for manual installation; `.app.tar.gz` and `.sig` files are for the in-app updater.
